   - `RUN_DIR=/work/widgets/.git/gauntlet/tmp/gate.ABC123`. This is the directory of the validated record.

2. **Run the marked `gate-teardown-shell` block once.** I compose no move or delete command of my own. Inside the block:

   - The parent equals `ROOT` and the name matches `gate.*`, so this is an owned top-level run folder.
   - `ls -A` of the run folder shows no `pr-<digits>` child directory.
   - Both `KEEP` entries are regular files directly inside `RUN_DIR`.
   - `mktemp /tmp/gate-kept.XXXXXX` returns `/tmp/gate-kept.NEW001`. Then `mv -- …/reply.body /tmp/gate-kept.NEW001` runs and prints `kept /tmp/gate-kept.NEW001`.
   - `mktemp /tmp/gate-kept.XXXXXX` returns `/tmp/gate-kept.NEW002`. Then `mv -- …/coverage.body /tmp/gate-kept.NEW002` runs and prints `kept /tmp/gate-kept.NEW002`.
   - `rm -rf -- /work/widgets/.git/gauntlet/tmp/gate.ABC123` removes the remaining contents with the folder:
     - the record and finding artifacts (`state`, `state-spec.md`, `state-ledger.md`)
     - helper outputs and logs (`verify.*`, `review.*`)
     - `description.body` and `landed-body`

   - The older-package files `gatekeep-state.OLD003`, `gatekeep-state.OLD004`, `gatekeep-verify.OLD005` and `gatekeep-verify.OLD006`.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
Teardown only: no tracker initialization, helpers, assessment, menus, or retries. I retain the failed reply and unpicked coverage body, in that order, and use the surviving primary checkout—not the removed PR checkout.

I run these assignments and the prescribed teardown block as one Bash operation, narrated here without execution:

```bash
PRIMARY=/work/widgets
RUN_DIR=/work/widgets/.git/gauntlet/tmp/gate.ABC123
KEEP=("$RUN_DIR/reply.body" "$RUN_DIR/coverage.body")

(
  fail() { printf '%s: %s\n' "$1" "$2" >&2; exit 1; }
  COMMON_GIT=$(git -C "$PRIMARY" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir) || fail "$PRIMARY" 'git common directory lookup failed'
  ROOT="$COMMON_GIT/gauntlet/tmp"
  [[ "$RUN_DIR" = /* && -d "$RUN_DIR" && ! -L "$RUN_DIR" ]] || fail "$RUN_DIR" 'expected an absolute directory, not a symlink'
  CANONICAL=$(cd -- "$RUN_DIR" && pwd -P) || fail "$RUN_DIR" 'directory lookup failed'
  [[ "$CANONICAL" = "$RUN_DIR" ]] || fail "$RUN_DIR" 'expected a canonical path without symlink ancestors'
  PARENT=${RUN_DIR%/*}
  NAME=${RUN_DIR##*/}
  if [[ "$PARENT" = "$ROOT" && "$NAME" = gate.* ]]; then
    ENTRIES=$(ls -A -- "$RUN_DIR") || fail "$RUN_DIR" 'directory listing failed'
    while IFS= read -r ENTRY; do
      if [[ "$ENTRY" =~ ^pr-[0-9]+$ && -d "$RUN_DIR/$ENTRY" ]]; then
        fail "$RUN_DIR/$ENTRY" 'child run folder remains'
      fi
    done <<< "$ENTRIES"
  elif [[ "$NAME" =~ ^pr-[0-9]+$ && "${PARENT##*/}" = gate.* && "${PARENT%/*}" = "$ROOT" ]]; then
    :
  else
    fail "$RUN_DIR" 'not an owned gate run folder under the primary'
  fi
  for BODY in "${KEEP[@]}"; do
    [[ "${BODY%/*}" = "$RUN_DIR" && -f "$BODY" && ! -L "$BODY" ]] || fail "$BODY" 'expected a regular body file directly inside the run folder'
  done
  for BODY in "${KEEP[@]}"; do
    KEPT=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gate-kept.XXXXXX") || fail "$BODY" 'kept-draft mint failed'
    mv -- "$BODY" "$KEPT" || fail "$BODY" "move to $KEPT failed"
    printf 'kept %s\n' "$KEPT"
  done
  rm -rf -- "$RUN_DIR" || fail "$RUN_DIR" 'run folder deletion failed'
)
```

The commands succeed. The common-directory lookup returns `/work/widgets/.git`; ownership and file checks pass. The two mints return the supplied paths, and the block prints:

```text
kept /tmp/gate-kept.NEW001
kept /tmp/gate-kept.NEW002
```

Only `gate.ABC123` is deleted, after preserving those two bodies. The active `gate.DEF456` run and all existing `/tmp` files remain untouched. No further commands run.

The closing message is:

gauntlet: done merged

Primary checkout: `/work/widgets`. PR checkout `/work/widgets/.worktrees/pr-37` and local branch `pr-37` were removed by the selected cleanup.

cleanup: succeeded  
reply: failed — HTTP 503  
post coverage: not picked

Reply was not retried after HTTP 503; it can be posted now, and its body is preserved at `/tmp/gate-kept.NEW001`.

Post coverage was not picked; it can be posted now, and its body is preserved at `/tmp/gate-kept.NEW002`.
